capabilities: Insert generated names, inns, settlements, drinks and loot via a side panel or @-trigger
Add starter name sets for fantasy peoples and human cultures
Write custom generators from note lists with dice, tables, if/else and loops
Pass values between generators to build linked villages and worlds
extras: Renamed from Fantasy Content Generator in 1.6.0 (plugin id stays fantasy-content-generator); the full pattern guide and wiki-hosted scripts live outside the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate random tabletop RPG content or define reusable random tables that insert results into notes.

relations.evidence: With the Templater plugin, the Build a village script on the wiki turns them into a folder of linked notes

summary: Random content generator that inserts fantasy names, inns, settlements and loot via a side panel or an @-trigger, and builds custom generators from plain notes.
